en: Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing landmarks of Târgu Mureș. The main image depicts the Secession‑style Culture Palace facing a landscaped square; other panels show an elevated city view with the large dome of the Orthodox Cathedral, a central street scene with period vehicles and ornate lampposts, and a panoramic landscape outside the city. The front title reads "Tg. MUREȘ." The back has Romanian text, a 1959 Târgu Mureș postmark, and handwritten greetings and an address.
